title: The three specified left scalar tensor chain maps
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y and fixed-scalar cochain complexes P,Q, construct the tuple of the actual three left chain maps: scalar realization of fixed tensor pullback, scalar total realization after fixed pullback, and the total tensor map of the two scalar complex comparisons. Each entry is the specified existing map, before taking degree components.

proof.text: Construct a heterogeneous tuple of the three explicit native chain maps. All data are the original specified maps; no compatibility or existence witness is chosen.
